_comment: Boot gate for GPT-2 training hosts (4090/5090 class). Unlike SmallCore this workload IS FLOP-bound, so bf16 throughput gets a real floor again (a healthy 4090 measures ~150+, a 5090 ~236; 80 rejects broken or misdescribed cards without rejecting an A100). drive_pull_mbps guards the 7.5 GB token-cache pull from the Drive bank. CAUTION: the gate measures a SINGLE stream, but the real pull uses 8 streams and runs 3-5x faster (measured repeatedly 2026-07-28/29). During Drive congestion a healthy Taiwan host measured 85.8 and the 100-threshold self-destroyed a good box (and silently killed another with no keep-alive); 60 single-stream ~= 200+ real, capping the pull at ~5 min. disk floor: the cache + checkpoints are written to /workspace, and a 10 MB/s disk burned a run on 2026-07-26. Re-derive with `launch.py scan` when changing GPU class.
